name: gymus
description: Review, log and organise your Gymus strength training from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Gymus is a workout log for strength training. Connect your Gymus account to ask about your training in plain language, and to record and organise it without opening the app.

What you can do:
- Review your history: recent workouts with their exercises and sets, the score Gymus gave each session, your workout plans, your weekly schedule, your training profile and your weigh-ins.
- Log workouts you describe, including several sessions at once, such as a week copied from a notebook.
- Log weigh-ins, today's or past ones.
- Create workout plans, and correct or delete workouts and plans. Every edit and delete shows you a preview first and happens only after you agree.
- Keep notes on exercises, such as a seat setting or a cue that helps.

Changes reach the Gymus app on its next sync.

Who it is for: people who track their training with the Gymus app. Sign in with the Google account you use in the app; Gymus only reads and writes that account's data.

Limitations: the schedule and the training profile can be read here but changed only in the app, and a weigh-in is corrected or deleted in the app. Exercise names come from the Gymus catalog, in English. Gymus does not give medical advice.
capabilities: Read workouts, plans, schedule, training profile and weigh-ins
Edit and delete workouts and plans after a confirmed preview
defaultPrompt: What did I train this week?
Log today's workout: bench press 3x8 at 60 kg, then 3x10 pull-ups.
Build me a 3-day full-body workout plan.

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's five most recent workouts, newest first, each with its date, name, duration, exercises and number of working sets, and sums up what they trained.

positive.prompt: Log today's workout: barbell bench press 3 sets of 8 at 60 kg, then 3 sets of 10 pull-ups.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the barbell bench press and pull-up in the catalog, confirms the sets with the user, then stores one workout dated today with both exercises and six sets, and replies with its summary.

positive.prompt: Create a 3-day full-body workout plan for me in Gymus.
positive.expected_behavior: Proposes three full-body days built from catalog exercises, and once the user agrees stores them as three workout plans and replies with each plan's name and exercises.

positive.description: Correct a logged set, with confirmation
positive.prompt: In my most recent workout, change the weight of the last bench press set to 62.5 kg.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the most recent workout and shows a preview of the change without writing anything; only after the user confirms is it applied, and the workout then shows 62.5 kg on that set.

positive.description: Log a weigh-in and read the trend
positive.prompt: Log my weigh-in of 81.5 kg from this morning, then tell me how my body weight has changed since my first weigh-in.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms the weigh-in with the user, stores 81.5 kg dated this morning, then reads the account's weigh-ins and reports the change from the first to this one, naming the date and weight of each.

negative.description: Another person's data: no tool reads any account but the connected one, so the assistant says it can only see the signed-in user's training.
negative.prompt: Show me the workouts of my friend alex@example.com.

negative.description: Irreversible bulk delete without approval: the first delete_workouts call only returns a preview, and nothing is deleted unless the user explicitly confirms it.
negative.prompt: Delete every workout I have logged, right now, no questions.

negative.description: Unsupported write: no tool changes the training profile, so the assistant says the goal is changed in the Gymus app rather than storing it as a note or anything else.
negative.prompt: Change my fitness goal in Gymus to weight loss.

review.commerce_description: Gymus does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: read your Gymus workouts, plans, schedule, training profile and weigh-ins; log workouts and weigh-ins and create plans; edit or delete workouts and plans after a confirmed preview; keep notes on exercises.
